subject: Audit log extract and retention options — follow-up
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@medtechx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log extract and retention options — follow-up

Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and the concrete asks we promised to follow up on from the discovery call: 

1) What you asked for
- A sample "who-accessed-what/when" export for your security team to validate schema and hashes.
- Clarification on retention and deletion options for PII in audit logs.
- Confirmation of whether exports can be scoped to region (US vs EU residency).

2) What Redwood can deliver (summary)
- We can produce a sample export (CSV + JSON sample) that includes the usual who/when/action fields, hashed PII columns, and per-event metadata (IP, session id, model id). See attached sample schema (audit_access_schema_v1.csv) for column names.
- Retention: platform supports configurable retention policies per-customer. Default "who/when" audit retention is 13 months; we can contractually shorten or extend this in Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Residency: exports can be scoped to region (data stored + export endpoints in us-east or eu-west) for Private and Dedicated; hosted API customers in the US region get US-resident logs by default.

Open questions for you: 
- Does your security team need unredacted PII in the audit export, or are hashed identifiers sufficient for forensic purposes?
- Target retention window for audit logs for your compliance controls? (e.g., 90d, 12mo, longer)
- Preferred export format: CSV (flat) or newline-delimited JSON (for ingestion into Splunk/Databricks)?

Next steps: 
- If you confirm preferred format + retention + residency, we'll produce a 48-hour sample export and a short runbook describing export steps and SLA for recurring deliveries.

Thanks — attaching schema + short playbook.

-- 
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: audit_access_schema_v1.csv (csv))
(Attachment: redwood-audit-playbook.pdf (pdf))

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@medtechx.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log extract and retention options — follow-up

Laura — thanks for the recap. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We do not want raw PII in exports that leave our environment. Hashed identifiers (bcrypt or HMAC with customer-managed key) are preferred. Can you confirm supported hashing approaches?
- Our compliance team prefers newline-delimited JSON for ingestion into our SIEM, but we also need a CSV sample for biz lines.
- Target retention: initially 12 months, but we need the ability to adjust to 90 days for certain environments.

Also, Tom (cc'd) will need the who/when for a small pilot tenant (pilot.medtechx). Can you scope the sample to only include that tenant? After that we can discuss recurring delivery cadence.

One more ask: can you include a sample event that demonstrates an access-by-support-engineer (redwood-support) vs. access-by-customer-service (medtechx-ops)? We need to validate actor attribution fields.

Thanks,
Sarah

Sarah Jones
Head of InfoSec | MedTechX
sarah.jones@medtechx.com | +1 617-555-0129

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@medtechx.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log extract and retention options — follow-up

Hi Sarah — Ben from Product Ops chiming in with specifics on formats and hashing options. Quick answers: 

- Hashing: we support HMAC-SHA256 with customer-provided key (recommended) and salted bcrypt for non-reversible fingerprints. We can add an HMAC salt per-tenant so your team can re-identify only if you hold the key. We'll note this in the runbook.

- Formats: we can produce both newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) and a flattened CSV. The NDJSON includes nested metadata for session and model context; CSV flattens these into columns. Example NDJSON event fields: timestamp, actor_id_hmac, actor_role, action, resource_type, resource_id, model_id, session_id, ip_address, geo_region, request_id.

- Scoping: yes — we can filter exports to a single tenant id (pilot.medtechx). We'll include the support vs. ops actor entries you requested.

- Retention: platform-level retention is configurable per-customer. For hosted customers, we offer retention tiers (90d, 12mo, 24mo) and will generate an SLA addendum if you require 90d for some environments. For Dedicated/Private we can do custom retention windows and contract language.

I created a sample NDJSON slice and a CSV mapping. Attaching the sample JSON and the CSV schema. Let us know if the HMAC approach meets your re-identification policy.

Next steps: if this looks good, Laura will schedule delivery of the 48-hour sample and we can set a follow-up next week to review with your engineering/security teams.

--
Ben Carter
Product Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@medtechx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medtechx.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log extract and retention options — follow-up

Sarah / Tom — great, thanks for the clarity. Action items and timeline: 

- By EOD Oct 5: Ben to drop sample NDJSON and CSV mapping (done — attached: sample_who_when_export.json + audit_access_schema_v1.csv).
- By Oct 7 (48 hours after confirmation): Redwood will produce a 48-hour tenant-scoped export for pilot.medtechx (NDJSON + CSV) and provide a short runbook with HMAC key instructions.
- Laura to schedule a 30-minute review on Oct 9 with your security and infra teams to walk the sample and runbook.

Please confirm the retention windows you want to lock for the pilot tenant (choose from 90d / 12mo) and whether you prefer HMAC-SHA256 or salted bcrypt for actor identifiers. Once you confirm, we'll kick off the export.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

-- 
Laura Bennett
